squat.criteria: Bodyweight variant. Comfortable shoulder-width stance, toes slightly outward, arms forward, feet fixed, hips back and knees bending together, controlled descent near parallel and return.

pulse-squat.criteria: Bodyweight variant. Lower near parallel, perform two small bottom-quarter pulses without standing between them, then rise. Feet remain flat and planted.

chair-pose.criteria: Hip-width variation, hips back with moderate knee bend, arms overhead, chest lifted and spine long. Enter, hold steadily, then stand and lower arms. Four-second displayed hold is illustrative, not the source breathing prescription.

sourceKind: Original procedural skinned animation informed by instructor references; no copied reference imagery.
limits: Eight-second instructional cycle; hold duration is illustrative. Barefoot procedural character. Only bodyweight squat is depicted, not loaded variants. No exhaustive cloth collision simulation, individual biomechanics, phone or production verification.
